judge_reasoning: The model solution has two fatal rules violations: (1) It declares Angel of Invention, the two Servo tokens, and the newly cast Sacred Cat as attackers, but all of these were just created/cast this turn and have summoning sickness, making them illegal attackers (vigilance does not grant haste). (2) It activates Ayli's second ability to exile Gideon while the player is still at 21 life, but this ability requires being at least 10 life above the starting life total (i.e., 30+ life), which is never reached in the model's plan since no life gain occurs before this activation. The official solution specifically builds up life via lifelink combat damage and an Ayli sacrifice to reach 30 life before exiling Gideon. The model's plan fails to achieve the objective legally.
model_solution:
1. Cast Sacred Cat ({W})
2. Cast Angel of Invention ({3}{W}{W}), choosing to create 2 Servo tokens
3. Declare attacks with all creatures (Ayli, Vampire Cutthroat, Indulgent Aristocrat, both Sacred Cats, Angel, both Servos)
4. After opponent declares blockers, activate Ayli's second ability: pay {1}{W}{B}, sacrifice Indulgent Aristocrat, and exile Gideon of the Trials
5. The emblem effect ends since Gideon is no longer on the battlefield
6. Assign combat damage: unblocked creatures (Vampire Cutthroat, Sacred Cat, and both Servos) deal 8 total damage to the opponent
7. Opponent dies from 3 life → -5 life
